name: East Timor
description: East Timor from its kingdoms and Portuguese Timor to the Indonesian occupation, the vote of 1999 and independence in 2002.

checkpoints.name: Portuguese Timor
checkpoints.note: Portuguese traders came for sandalwood in the 1500s, and Timor stayed a Portuguese colony for centuries.

checkpoints.name: Occupation
checkpoints.note: Indonesia invaded in 1975. Perhaps a quarter of the people died under the occupation, and the resistance fought on.

checkpoints.name: Independence
checkpoints.note: East Timor voted for independence in 1999 and became independent in 2002. In 2025 it joined ASEAN.
